entries.title: Dispatch endpoint missing in staging
entries.root_cause: The staging job does not provide QUAY_DISPATCH_URL, which the dispatch settings require. Add that variable to the staging environment.

entries.title: Receipt region missing in staging
entries.root_cause: The staging job does not provide QUAY_RECEIPT_REGION, which the receipt settings require. Add that separate variable to the staging environment.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same settings loader raises a KeyError for the receipt region instead of the dispatch endpoint; the two settings require different environment variables.
